subject: Re: M-Theory numerics — compute + staffing
body:
Anders,

Resourcing rundown.

Staffing: Yara at 50% as TL, Giannis and Maren at 40% each on the scan infrastructure, Farah at 20% for the colab loader/mirror plumbing. That holds through June.

Compute: the small scans run fine on titan-a100 best-effort. For the large-scale critical-point scan we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation — 256 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-22, confirmed in the quarterly allocation for graphs-retrieval. That lands the scan results right before the 06-26 OKR lock, which is tight but workable if the scan code is stable by mid-June.

One wrinkle: vulcan is down for maintenance 06-22 to 06-24, so everyone will be piling onto the other pools that week. Being on cirrus keeps us insulated.

Bruno
